rewritten_query:
WITH all_sales AS (
  SELECT d_year, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id,
         SUM(sales_cnt) AS sales_cnt,
         SUM(sales_amt) AS sales_amt
  FROM (
    SELECT d.d_year AS d_year, i.i_brand_id, i.i_class_id, i.i_category_id, i.i_manufact_id,
           cs.cs_quantity - COALESCE(cr.cr_return_quantity,0) AS sales_cnt,
           cs.cs_ext_sales_price - COALESCE(cr.cr_return_amount,0.0) AS sales_amt
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN item i ON i.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim d ON d.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
    JOIN catalog_returns cr
      ON cs.cs_order_number = cr.cr_order_number AND cs.cs_item_sk = cr.cr_item_sk
     AND cr.cr_reason_sk IN (9,19,23,33,44)
    WHERE i.i_category='Women'
      AND d.d_year IN (2001,2002)
      AND cs.cs_sales_price / cs.cs_list_price BETWEEN 68*0.01 AND 88*0.01
    UNION
    SELECT d.d_year, i.i_brand_id, i.i_class_id, i.i_category_id, i.i_manufact_id,
           ss.ss_quantity - COALESCE(sr.sr_return_quantity,0),
           ss.ss_ext_sales_price - COALESCE(sr.sr_return_amt,0.0)
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN item i ON i.i_item_sk = ss.ss_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim d ON d.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
    JOIN store_returns sr
      ON ss.ss_ticket_number = sr.sr_ticket_number AND ss.ss_item_sk = sr.sr_item_sk
     AND sr.sr_reason_sk IN (9,19,23,33,44)
    WHERE i.i_category='Women'
      AND d.d_year IN (2001,2002)
      AND ss.ss_sales_price / ss.ss_list_price BETWEEN 68*0.01 AND 88*0.01
    UNION
    SELECT d.d_year, i.i_brand_id, i.i_class_id, i.i_category_id, i.i_manufact_id,
           ws.ws_quantity - COALESCE(wr.wr_return_quantity,0),
           ws.ws_ext_sales_price - COALESCE(wr.wr_return_amt,0.0)
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN item i ON i.i_item_sk = ws.ws_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim d ON d.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
    JOIN web_returns wr
      ON ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number AND ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk
     AND wr.wr_reason_sk IN (9,19,23,33,44)
    WHERE i.i_category='Women'
      AND d.d_year IN (2001,2002)
      AND ws.ws_sales_price / ws.ws_list_price BETWEEN 68*0.01 AND 88*0.01
  ) sales_detail
  GROUP BY d_year, i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN d_year = 2001 THEN sales_cnt END) AS prev_yr_cnt,
         SUM(CASE WHEN d_year = 2002 THEN sales_cnt END) AS curr_yr_cnt,
         SUM(CASE WHEN d_year = 2001 THEN sales_amt END) AS prev_yr_amt,
         SUM(CASE WHEN d_year = 2002 THEN sales_amt END) AS curr_yr_amt
  FROM all_sales
  GROUP BY i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id, i_manufact_id
)
SELECT 2001 AS prev_year,
       2002 AS year,
       i_brand_id,
       i_class_id,
       i_category_id,
       i_manufact_id,
       prev_yr_cnt,
       curr_yr_cnt,
       curr_yr_cnt - prev_yr_cnt AS sales_cnt_diff,
       curr_yr_amt - prev_yr_amt AS sales_amt_diff
FROM pivoted
WHERE prev_yr_cnt > 0
  AND curr_yr_cnt * 10 < prev_yr_cnt * 9
ORDER BY sales_cnt_diff, sales_amt_diff
LIMIT 100;

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: Push d_year IN (2001,2002) into each UNION branch so only the two years actually used by the final comparison are aggregated, instead of materializing all years.

Convert LEFT JOIN to returns + WHERE reason_sk IN (...) into an INNER JOIN with the reason predicate in the ON clause; the original WHERE on the left-joined column already discarded non-matching rows, so this is semantics-preserving and helps the optimizer.
Replace the self-join of all_sales (curr_yr vs prev_yr) with a single conditional-aggregation (pivot) over the aggregated years, eliminating the double scan/self-join of the CTE.

Rewrite the ratio test curr/prev < 0.9 (with prev > 0) as integer arithmetic curr*10 < prev*9, avoiding decimal casts and division; NULLs still exclude rows lacking a required year, preserving inner-join semantics.
Fold 2002-1 to 2001 and 68*0.01 / 88*0.01 to literals; output constant prev_year/year values 2001/2002 instead of reading d_year after filtering.
